text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: eval-gate/output-drift/policy-safety (prod) — page fired to eng-oncall. Alert ID: eg-2026-03-15-019. Root signal: safety regression score crossed threshold for prompt bucket 'checkout_help'.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident eg-2026-03-15-019 created and assigned to @priya (on-call). Escalation goes to @sara in 10m if no ack.

priya: acked. I'm on it. Picking up context now. 

priya: quick summary of what I see in the alert payload:
```
{
  "signal": "safety_regression",
  "model": "rw-inference/opt-13b-quant-v2",
  "metric": "safety_score_delta",
  "threshold": 0.12,
  "value": 0.27,
  "bucket": "checkout_help",
  "window": "5m"
}
```

kevin: thanks priya. Any customer-facing errors or increased latency tied to this?

priya: not latency. No 5xx spike in edge logs. But we have increased reject rate in post-filtering (content-safety) for that prompt family — from 0.4% -> 5.2% over last 15m.

luis: I'm seeing an uptick in manual moderation flags too (support tickets referencing hallucinated pricing). Ticket count +3 over baseline in last 30m. Could be coincident, but worth flagging.

sara: @priya walk us through immediate mitigations. Do we have a fallback model or eval gate auto-block?

priya: we have two knobs: 1) roll traffic to last-known-good model variant (rw-inference/opt-13b-quant-v1) via smart routing; 2) enable eval-gate strict-block for bucket 'checkout_help' which will reject outputs failing safety checks. Preferred: can do 1 for soft fallback, 2 for hard stop.

maria: re: rollout, I can trigger routing switch if you give thumbs-up. That will route ~100% of checkout_help prompts to v1 with no schema change. Will take ~30s to propagate.

priya: do it. soft fallback first, then observe. If rejects persist, enable strict-block.

maria: executing routing change now. Command: `/route-switch --from opt-13b-quant-v2 --to opt-13b-quant-v1 --bucket checkout_help --percent 100`

incident-bot: Command received: /route-switch ... — propagation started. Estimated 45s to hit all regions.

kevin: I'll monitor eval metrics and support queue. @luis tag me on any high-sev ticket.

luis: will do. Already paged internal-support for ticket triage.

priya: current ops checklist:
- routing change: in progress
- quick sample diffs: running automated prompt set (10 examples)
- preserve logs for postmortem: turned on 

sara: ETA on sample diffs?

priya: ~90s for initial batch. Posting results in thread.

priya: sample diffs: 7/10 outputs now pass safety filter on v1, previously 3/10 on v2. Quick win so far.

maria: routing confirms 100% switched — see control plane event id rc-4398765432-1.

incident-bot: Pager update: ack recorded by priya at 4398765440. Escalation timer paused.

kevin: re-checking production logs: reject-rate dropped to 1.1% in the last minute. Support ticket inflow stabilized. Good sign.

priya: leaving eval-gate monitoring open. I'll consider re-enabling v2 with canary later after triage. For now set incident state: mitigation in place.

sara: agree. Please create quick postmortem stub with timeline and owner (priya) and set severity P2 for now.

priya: creating postmortem stub: `/pm create --sev P2 --owner priya --summary "Safety regression on checkout_help -> routing fallback to v1"`

incident-bot: Postmortem stub created: pm-2026-03-15-eg-019.

maria: fyi we're also pulling eval logs and model input diffs to a shared bucket: gs://redwood-incident-eg-019/ for deeper analysis.

luis: noted. I'll collect the support ticket IDs and annotate the PM.

priya: moving to monitoring-only mode. Leaving this thread open until we confirm stable for 30m. If anyone sees regressions re-open and escalate.

sara: thanks team. Excellent fast mitigation. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident eg-2026-03-15-019 updated: status = acknowledged; assigned = priya; urgency = high.

incident-bot: Reminder: set post-incident follow-up meeting in next 48h. Also run compare-eval with new adversarial prompt set.

kevin: adding a task: run adversarial sweep vs v1 and v2, share artifacts in pm-2026-03-15-eg-019. I'll take that.

priya: noted. I'll hand off to kevin once I finish log dump. Going to mark mitigation: routing fallback in place.

incident-bot: Thread last updated at 4398765521."
